title: payload for capability learner.stage-result.append
description: Derived from the los CLI parser for this capability's named command. Do not hand-edit; regenerate with tools/generate_capability_schemas.py.

activity.description: what was done in the recorded attempt; free text

assistance.description: optional note on assistance used during the attempt

condition.description: a condition label for this attempt; labels only until a target is authored

note.description: free-text note stored with the result; prose only, never evidence

result.description: outcome of the recorded attempt: correct, incorrect, partial or abandoned

stage.description: stage of the unit's current study map the result is recorded against

supersedes.description: explicitly correct one earlier stage result; preserves its bytes

unit.description: unit whose stage the result is recorded against

workspace.description: id of the registered active workspace owning the ledger
